text:
marina: quick sync 1 - users hit two issues with embeddings: zero-length items and very long strings. need clear API contract so SDKs and docs align.
aj: clarifying Q: zero-length as "" vs explicit null in list vs missing slot? behavior differs today.
marina: both "" and explicit "\u0000-length" items (empty string) showed up. one user also complained that >64k chars got silently dropped and returned a vector that looked like it matched a truncated input.
samuel: current service truncates inputs at 65536 bytes on the ingest path and proceeds to produce a vector. we do not emit an error for truncated items.
qa-kyle: that silent truncation caused a production ranking regression in staging yesterday when a PDF OCR blob got cut. we should treat it as high risk and add tests.
docu: proposal: add a parameter `truncate_behavior` (string) with allowed values: `silent` (default), `error`, `chunk`. - `silent`: keep current behavior for backward compatibility. - `error`: fail the request for any item exceeding the limit. - `chunk`: split long input into multiple items and return mapping so callers can reassemble vectors.
marina: good. for empty strings what should we return as vector? options: zero vector, null, or deterministic small noise.
docu: recommend zero vector to preserve output shape and simplify downstream batching. include per-item meta to indicate `was_empty: true`. keep vectors array length equal to input array length unless `chunk` is used.
aj: example request shape: ```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-1",
  "items": ["", "super long text..."],
  "truncate_behavior": "error"
}
```
samuel: implementor notes: `chunk` complicates ordering and streaming. if `chunk` is used, response must include `item_mapping` that maps original index -> list of vector indices. otherwise callers will mis-associate results.
marina: agree. also add an optional header for migration: `Accept-Truncation: true` which we can require if we ever flip the default from `silent` to `error`. that avoids sudden failures.
docu: suggested response schema (sketch as text, not a hard spec): ```json
{
  "vectors": [[0.0, 0.0, ...], [0.123, 0.234, ...]],
  "item_meta": [
    {"was_empty": true},
    {"truncated": true, "original_length": 90000}
  ],
  "item_mapping": null
}
```
qa-kyle: test matrix I will add: empty string, explicit null (should be treated as a missing item and return null in meta), missing slot (array index skipped), length = 65536, length = 65537, and several unicode multi-byte boundaries. will add fuzz harness up to 200k chars to ensure split/chunk correctness.
aj: SDK changes: expose truncate_behavior param, default to `silent` for now, and surface header Accept-Truncation when the SDK opts into stricter mode. add quicknote in changelog.
samuel: backend TODOs: - add param parsing and validation - wire into ingest truncation routine - produce `item_meta` entries - support `chunk` by producing additional vectors and mapping - log truncation events to telemetry with sample snippets (redacted)
marina: PR plan? samuel: i'll open draft PR and ping reviewers. merging order: API layer + tests -> SDK -> docs -> canary deploy.
samuel: draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1234 (WIP). reviewers: @aj @docu.
ops-bot: rolling canary scheduled 2024-07-15T21:16:10Z.
aj: i'll review the PR this afternoon. qa-kyle: once tests land, can you run the regression suite on staging?
qa-kyle: yes, will run full matrix and post failures. adding unit tests for null vs empty semantics.
marina: thanks everyone. i'll cut an SDK patch that exposes the new param and sets defaults. will post a follow-up here when released. :thumbsup:
